todos: [P2] LIVE-MODEL-HARDWARE-01: The live harness accepts ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL without changing saved settings. On 2026-09-28 qwen3.5:4b was 100% GPU at 8K/16K (about 5.4-5.7 GiB VRAM, 72-75 generated tok/s in initial runs); two runs stopped on context overflow before the fix. After the fix, an isolated 16K run reached 50/50 turns without overflow, completed 51 tool calls and 3/9 milestones, then stopped at step_budget with a failed build. A same-prompt 16K qwen3.5:2b run was 100% GPU (2.6 GB Ollama model memory, 4.6 GiB total VRAM used), about 103 generated and 18,943 prompt tok/s over 45 generations, 50 tool calls (12 failed/blocked), 1/9 milestones, failed build and blocked/step_budget at 50/50 in 186 seconds. Neither model meets the qualification threshold, so no usable default is selected. The 9b model is 6.6 GB before context and likely to exceed 8 GiB VRAM. A 2026-09-28 pull was interrupted after about 154 MB when throughput fell to 3.8-4.7 MB/s (over 20 minutes remaining); it is not installed or measured. Ollama retained 17 resumable partial blob files for this digest in its model store; do not treat them as app userData. On 2026-09-29 a resumed ollama pull again measured about 4.6 MB/s with over 23 minutes estimated; it was interrupted after about 175 MB of displayed progress. The 9B remains absent from ollama list and its partial cache remains resumable. Resume only when bandwidth permits, then measure residency before a full run. Audit snapshots remain under %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live. Snapshot inspection on 2026-09-28 found that 2B left src/main.tsx importing absent src/App and src/index.css; 4B left src/App.tsx importing absent src/components/Sidebar and src/pages/TasksPage while src/pages/Tasks.tsx exists. The 4B run failed npm run build at step 42, made six successful file edits at steps 43-48, then failed build again at step 50 with TS2307 and TS2614. The focused qwen3.5:4b TS2613 probe reached 12/12 with a final buildable source. Its application-owned verification passed, but the milestone remained open because the human-readable command label .: npm run build was compared with npm run build; this mapping is now fixed and has a regression test. The run still ends blocked at step_budget by design, and the model spent steps editing tsconfig unnecessarily. The isolated 2026-09-28 qwen3.5:4b TS2613 rerun passed its live test: the final build succeeded and 1/1 milestone was verified at step 12/12, confirming the command-label fix. The run remained unverifiable at step_budget and the model again edited tsconfig unnecessarily. A post-fix 16K full-task rerun on 2026-09-28 verified 3/9 milestones in 20/50 steps and stopped blocked/circuit_breaker on no_mutation; after step 8 the model only inspected files and made two failed shell calls, without running the final build. The live test exited 1. On 2026-09-29 the exact first sequence prompt ran with qwen3.5:4b at 16K, 100% GPU (3.6 GB Ollama model memory); it reached 50/50 steps and 5/9 milestones, then stopped blocked/step_budget. Its final build passed but the generated page is blank at runtime because DashboardPage uses Button without importing it. The model remains unqualified; do not select it as default without a successful full-task qualification. Model source: https://ollama.com/library/qwen3.5 . The 2026-09-29 post-fix exact-prompt qwen3.5:4b run stopped at step 15/50 with 0/9 milestones on no_mutation; the placeholder npm test failed before browser verification. This strengthens the unqualified verdict.

A second isolated desktop run of the exact first prompt on 2026-09-29 generated a contradictory CRA/root-index/Vitest plan, then stopped blocked/model_silence at step 3/50 with 0/9 milestones and no application files: prose and fenced JSON were correctly not executed. The greenfield plan inconsistency is corrected: the 2026-09-29 exact first-prompt run with qwen3.5:4b planned React/Vite and used native tools, but stopped blocked/step_budget at 50/50 with 5/9 milestones. Independent npm run build passed, npm test failed because no script exists, and Chrome rendered an empty page with Button is not defined in DashboardPage. src/services and Tailwind CSS output are absent. Qualify a model on the complete prompt in a fresh isolated workspace and verify build, tests, preview at 320px-1920px, milestone evidence and requested workflow. Keep C:\Users\Utente\Desktop\test_app read-only. On 2026-09-29 the web-ui smoke gate, visual milestone evidence, unreachable src/index.js and missing acceptance directories were corrected; 283 fast-suite files (2272 tests), typecheck and static quality passed. A direct six-width Chrome live smoke against the prior green-build workspace detected Button is not defined and missing compiled CSS. The exact-prompt qwen3.5:4b rerun stopped at step 15/50 with 0/9 milestones after 12 non-mutating steps; its npm test placeholder failed. Browser feedback to the model in a complete run, usable navigation, touch targets and final qualification remain unverified. Preserve its workspace and 2026-09-29T19-30-41-546Z audit snapshot. Next session: inspect the 15-step no_mutation trajectory and placeholder npm test, distinguish model behavior from an application directive or guard defect, then rerun the exact first prompt with a model fitting 8 GiB VRAM. Require passing build and tests, browser feedback reaching the model, working navigation, responsive checks at 320-1920 px, and milestone evidence before qualification.
